items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Lester never played with the band.

ctx.x: Well a guy named Arthur Horrell, he was a very popular trumpet player in around Gary, Indiana, in Chicago. A guy named, oh I've forgotten what his name is, but we called him Shaky. He was a trumpet player, we had three trumpets in the ring. We was a trumpet. And the saxophone section of the guy had a guy named Charles Reeves, and Ray Holloway, playing tenor, and Bean Bowl, I forgot Bean's first name, everybody called him Bean Bowl. He was playing baritone. And Chuck McClendon played tenor, saxophone. We had four…
And the last two I know were from New Orleans. Who else was from New Orleans in that band? Lester never played with the band. Excuse me? Lester didn't play with that band.
Oh no, you mentioned Hogan and Bill Jones. Yeah. Bill Jones played guitar and Hogan played drums. Okay. And that was with the Lloyd Price band?
